summary: The Job task panel's Machine dropdown and New Machine button move from the General tab to the top of the Output tab, the placeholder entry becomes "(Legacy post-processor)" in both the Job panel and the Post Process dialog, selecting a machine now hides the Processor and Arguments rows, and MachineFactory.list_configurations no longer returns an "<any>" entry.

pages.reason: PathEdit.ui: machineGroup removed from General tab and jobMachine/jobMachineNew inserted as row 0 of the Output tab; Job.py: combo gains '(Legacy post-processor)' first entry and updatePostProcessorVisibility hides Processor/Arguments rows when a machine is selected

Job.py: machine is now chosen on the Output tab, '<any>' placeholder replaced by '(Legacy post-processor)', and post-processor fields are hidden once a machine is set; machine.py: list_configurations no longer returns '<any>'

Job.py/PathEdit.ui: machine selection moved to the Job Output tab with '(Legacy post-processor)' as the no-machine entry; machine.py: list_configuration_files/list_configurations drop the '<any>' placeholder
DlgPostProcess.py: machine combo placeholder text changes from '(none)' to '(Legacy post-processor)'; Job.py: Job Output tab now hides Processor/Arguments when a machine is selected
